body.name: Three-node fork counterfamily
body.construction: Take the fork \(1\to2\), \(1\to3\) with coefficients \(2\) and \(3\), \(\omega=(1,1,1)\), and \(\tau=(3,4,5)\); its pairwise rank matrix is \(\begin{pmatrix}0&1&2&2\\1&0&2&2\\2&2&0&3\\2&2&3&0\end{pmatrix}\). Retain the open parameter neighborhood on which these ranks remain unchanged.
